title: Counit-normalized ambient scalar shift
statement: Let l be prime. Coefficient fields are finite extensions of Q_l with specified Q_l-algebra embeddings. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaves and raw rationalizations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Schemes supporting a constructible rational category are assumed noetherian, finite-dimensional, with l invertible; ambient operation comparisons are for arbitrary scheme morphisms g : X → Y in the actual ambient derived categories. The ambient derived tensor functor for a finite coefficient-field embedding has a unique commutation structure with integer shifts for which its fixed universal derived counit is shift-compatible. The scalar adjunction normalized on K-flat resolutions and the balanced ambient tensor associator respect that same shift structure.

source.place: Order 1307; existing scalar-extension component, relocated without changing signatures or proofs.

proof.text: The universal left-derived tensor is the right Kan extension along the homotopy localization. The coherent-shift theorem supplies a shift structure whose counit commutes with shifts. To prove uniqueness, postcompose the Kan extension by each shift equivalence and cancel the mapped localization shift comparison. Kan uniqueness and extensionality of shift structures identify any two choices.

On flat-term K-flat resolutions, the normalized scalar adjunction unit is the ordinary tensor unit. Its derived unit equation and the coherent derived-adjunction shift lemma show that the scalar adjunction respects the selected counit-normalized shifts. The balanced ambient associator is its adjunction conjugate, so its shift equation follows from the scalar restriction compositor and conjugacy.
